facts: Result: Old Lions won by 34 runs
Toss: Old Lions won the toss and batted
Innings: Kensington Ridge CC 234 all out (46.3 overs)
Batting: Thabo Mokoena 112 off 118 balls (11 fours, 3 sixes)
Batting: Sipho Ndlovu 47 off 52 balls (6 fours)
Batting: Aiden Naidoo 31* off 22 balls (2 fours, 2 sixes)
Bowling: Musa Khumalo 4 for 38 off 9.3 overs
Bowling: Liam Botha 2 for 44 off 10 overs
Player of the match: Thabo Mokoena (112 off 118 balls (11 fours, 3 sixes))

captions.facebook: What a Saturday at Old Lions Oval! 🦁 The 1st XI beat Kensington Ridge CC by 34 runs in Premier League Round 4, posting 268/7 after winning the toss and then bowling the visitors out for 234. Player of the match is Thabo Mokoena, who smashed 112 off 118 balls with 11 fours and 3 sixes, backed up by Sipho Ndlovu's 47, Aiden Naidoo's quickfire 31* off 22 and Musa Khumalo's 4 for 38. Well played to Kensington Ridge for a good contest!
